mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id AS userId, r.ranking, r.score, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl FROM challenge_ranking r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.recorded_date = #{recordedDate} AND u.is_active = true AND u.is_challenge_enabled = true ORDER BY r.ranking ASC LIMIT 10
